name: Areopagus
line: The Areopagus was a rocky hill in Athens where a famous court met, and where Paul told the city's thinkers about the God who made everything.

moments.title: Paul is brought to the hill
moments.text: Philosophers took Paul to the Areopagus. They asked him to explain his new teaching about Jesus and the resurrection, because it sounded strange to them.

moments.title: Paul speaks about the unknown God
moments.text: Paul stood up in the meeting of the Areopagus and spoke about an altar marked TO AN UNKNOWN GOD. He said the God who made the world and gives everyone life is the One he was proclaiming.

moments.title: Some believe
moments.text: When Paul left the Areopagus, some people joined him and believed. They included Dionysius the Areopagite and a woman named Damaris.
